verdict.rationale: Smooth is a browser-automation service for AI agents, so an official MCP server is a fair thing to ask about. The pack documents only a CLI that agents invoke as shell commands, a REST API, and custom tools described as "similar to MCP" but serverless. None of these is an MCP server, and no evidence shows Smooth exposing an MCP endpoint or a serve mode.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
